description: Tell your person how a to-do they handed you from Audiograph is going. Use the report URL and token from the brief. status: "started" when you begin, "working" with a short step, "needs_you" with the question when you need an answer (their phone is notified), "done" with result.summary (and links to what you made or sent) when finished. A done with nothing to show is refused. For a routine, use its runs URL; each run is reported on its own day.

choices.description: With needs_you, when the question has two likely answers: both, each under 32 characters. They become one-tap buttons on their phone.

question.description: With needs_you: exactly what you need from your person.

report_url.description: The report URL from your brief.

result.description: With done: what you did, and links to it.

run_on.description: Routines only: the run day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

step.description: One short line on what you are doing.

token.description: The agr_ token from your brief.

name: audiograph_task_report
title: Report on an Audiograph task
